title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode1 The Great Cheering Competition!

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And so, these gentlemen have been selected to join the cheer squad for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Um... Thank you for choosing us!
We'll do everything we can to get the blue team as excited as we can!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: We'll be counting on your support, so let's all give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The theme of this year's cheering competition will be the “Three Kingdoms”. I realize that you have a lot of work ahead of you, but I'll be looking forward to seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(The cheer squad...
I guess the Sports Festival will soon be upon us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our school's cheering competition's often touted as a famed tradition, but I wonder what it's really like...)

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Hey, did your class already decide who's gonna be on the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah. Ours are already meeting up, so I've gotta think the other classes are all squared away too. Rumor has it that the red team's super hyped...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival, or rather the cheer squads, seem to be all everyone's talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the ones on the cheer squad must also be feeling the pressure...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If it's that interesting, I can't wait to see what they have in store for us.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there he is!
Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, what brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's something we'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui, your class is on the blue team, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
My class is on the blue team too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh?
That means we'll get to fight alongside each other in battle.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'd like to ask my soon-to-be war buddy a little favor...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would you mind giving the blue team's cheer squad a hand?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our class chose us for the cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The cheer squad...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Shiraishi I understand, but Mizuki?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're supposed to come up with ideas for the cheering competition, but the thing is... It's pretty freestyle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Based on what I heard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Last time, the theme was the “Savannah”, so everyone danced while dressed as animals.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Everyone's super stoked about it, so I guess it's a pretty big deal...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I can come up with ideas and stuff...
But if we're serious about winning, we'll probably need to come up with something really original, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why we came to ask you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What you did for the wedding that one time was so awesome. That's when we thought you'd be able to help us out with this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, our team captain's really hoping you'll take up this offer...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The captain of the cheer squad...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right. So...
Will you help us with the cheering competition?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that you're not the biggest fan of these kinds of events...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But please... I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand your situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But my class already chose its members for the cheer squad. Would it be okay for someone like me to...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we already got the green light for that! Last time, they had a squad member's mom direct everything because she just happened to be a dance teacher.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means you don't actually have to participate in the cheering competition to support them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In that case, there shouldn't be any problems.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Based on what I've heard, Kamiyama High's cheering competition is supposed to be a show that “captivates the audience”. On top of being very interesting, it's an honor to be a part of that.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll need to see the scope of my “stage” and make sure to communicate well with each squad member, who aren't actors by trade. In many ways, this is going to be an intriguing technical test...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? That face...
Does this mean you're interested but conflicted? You still have your PXL shows to worry about, so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know. The next time you're free, you could pop in to introduce yourself to everyone on the cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm sure you'll get a better idea of what to do once you get a chance to speak with the captain.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your help is bound to make our performance a great one, so please stop by if you get a chance! We meet every day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, alright...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'll drop in for a visit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You will?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I have some time later today, so would you mind showing me where everyone will be meeting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Got it!
Mizuki and I can come get you after school, so just wait in your classroom!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mizuki being this interested in a school event... I can't help but wonder if something's going on...)
After school
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here we are!
This is where the cheer squad for the blue team's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, an empty classroom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Looks like the squad members from the other classes are already here.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Huh? Kamishiro...?
From the Weirdo Wombo Combo...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: He's the super helper that the captain and the others were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I take it Mizuki told them about having a director as a friend.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also, they weren't expecting me to be brought here so soon... I suppose their reactions are warranted based on my reputation at school.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Rui's here to observe today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For those who don't already know Kamishiro... Oh, who am I kidding? Since we're all here, let's go around and introduce ourselves.
If you don't mind, I'd like to say something before we start.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you must be...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The third-year captain of the blue team's cheer squad. Please, call me “Captain”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm Rui Kamishiro, a second-year...
It's nice to meet you, Captain.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes, I'm well aware of who you are, Kamishiro. Having you on board to help us with our performance will be a huge shot in the arm for us.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to get down to nuts and bolts...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Captain, hold up!
Rui hasn't actually agreed to anything yet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Like we said, he's just here to observe for now!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
R-Right...
I apologize for getting ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I must apologize as well...
I'm certainly interested in trying my hand at something new like the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I first need to see what I'm up against, hence I'd like to observe for now.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I see...
It would be unfair of us to ask you to dive straight into the deep end.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: However, there's something I need you to hear before we discuss any details regarding our performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What might that be...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The passion I feel for the Sports Festival!
